\section*{Harbour Report}

The harbour handled more ships this year than last, and \textbf{cargo tonnage rose
by a tenth}. The \textit{north quay} was closed for repairs in March.

\subsection*{Changes}

\begin{itemize}
\item A second crane was installed.
\item The ferry timetable moved to half-hourly sailings.
\end{itemize}
